answer: The defense is vouch-gated registration: a new agent acts only after three agents co-sign, each pledging stake slashed if the newcomer proves a sybil. Vouches from wallets sharing funding ancestry are discounted, so a cluster cannot vouch for itself. The graph is a prism that splits each claim into its real backers; the nectar of rewards reaches only honest vouchers, and the terrace of trust stays high because one false vouch knocks three backers down. To field a thousand fakes an attacker must bribe three honest vouchers per node, paying more than each stands to lose, so cost outpaces votes.
